Direct full-text comparison and targeted semantic searches found no coverage; later unindexed proof remains possible.
residual_risks: Later unindexed or differently named proof of Davis 2013 Conjecture 1.2 could exist; a negative search is not a novelty guarantee.

Independent mathematical or priority audit has not been performed.

value.rationale: Solves an explicit published 2013 number-theory conjecture on reciprocal binomial sums for all dyadic levels, with an all-integer-step strengthening. Converts a precise conditional 2-adic definability criterion into an unconditional one and substantially surpasses the previously proved e-k-1 estimate. The exact invariant is mathematically motivated by p-adic convergence, not an arbitrary slice or routine renaming.
